<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CustomPrint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/custom-3d-print">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Instruction" name="Instruction to create project"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Draft" name="Draft model"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ChangeRequest" name="Change request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CustomPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Instruction" name="Instruction" sourceRef="Task_Instruct" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="Draft model" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" name="Change request" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer 3D print process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Craving" name="Craving a custom 3D model"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Instruct" name="Instruct artist to create project" messageRef="Msg_Instruction"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches to artist" messageRef="Msg_Sketches"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft from artist">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReceiveDraft" messageRef="Msg_Draft"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewDraft" name="Review draft"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with result?"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell artist what to change" messageRef="Msg_ChangeRequest"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock" name="Color in stock at home?"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check remaining color amount"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Less than 100 g left?" default="Flow_NotUnder100"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddToShoppingList" name="Put color on shopping list"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderColor" name="Order color"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PlasticReceived" name="Plastic received"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PlasticReady" name="Plastic available"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Start printer preparation and G-code generation"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on printer and heat bed and extruder">
      <bpmn:documentation>The printer continuously sends its status back while the bed and extruder heat up.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from STL file"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Printer and G-code ready"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ModelPrinted" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Craving" targetRef="Task_Instruct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_Instruct" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Task_ReviewDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDraft" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06_NotSatisfied" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${satisfied == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08_Satisfied" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${satisfied == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_InStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10_InStock" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${inStock == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11_NotInStock" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_OrderColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${inStock == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13_Under100" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddToShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${remainingGrams < 100}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotUnder100" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_PlasticReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_AddToShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_PlasticReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_OrderColor" targetRef="Event_PlasticReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Event_PlasticReceived" targetRef="Gateway_PlasticReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_PlasticReady" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="End_ModelPrinted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
